howToPlay: Use your range to attack safely from behind walls. Combine the Satchel Charge gadget with your attacks to stun enemies, or use Dyna-Jump to leap over obstacles and escape danger.
gears: Equip Damage to boost your offensive output and Gadget Cooldown to use your abilities more frequently.
trait: This brawler is ideal for players who excel at long-range positioning and strategic map control.
